entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Gambit is typechecked, tested in TypeScript and GDScript, and exported; every .dev diagram is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/chess, or anything under .github/ (ci.yml).
checks: Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates, cached by version
npm test: tsc --noEmit, then the node:test suites in test/
npm run test:godot: import, then tests/test_rules.gd and tests/test_formats.gd headless
npm run build: the Godot web export, the engine split into parts, bridge.js and Stockfish
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
The Database migration check, when worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change
notChecked: The knowledge files: Meta/Agents/Knowledge/validate_knowledge.py is not run in CI.
How the game looks: the reference renders are compared by hand.
The game in a real browser, the GameRoom's WebSockets, Stockfish, and the login service.
worker/retire-sessions.sql, which the migration check does not watch.

entities.title: On a push to main
entities.summary: The same steps again, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: A push to main that changes games/chess or .github/, or Run workflow on the Deploy workflow (chess or all).
checks: The migration gate: every database change since the last deploy has been acknowledged
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
